issue.title: Recent reports list says "1 recipients"
issue.body:
On the dashboard, the list of recent reports shows how many people each report
went to. For our board pack, which goes only to the CFO, the line reads "Board
pack 1 recipients". A small thing, but the dashboard is what we put on the
screen in the Monday meeting.

input.title: Use singular "recipient" when a report has one recipient
input.body:
File: src/report.tsx

The ReportLine component renders `{report.deliveredTo.length} recipients` unconditionally, so a report delivered to one person shows "1 recipients". Change the label so it reads "recipient" when deliveredTo.length is 1 and "recipients" otherwise (zero and all other counts keep the plural).

Thanks for the detailed report; here is what triage found.

ReportLine always renders "recipients" after the count, so a report with one recipient reads "1 recipients". The plural is hard-coded on line 11 of src/report.tsx, inside the <small> tag. The fix is a singular/plural choice in this component; a draft pull request (pr-38) proposes it.

In short: reportLine always renders "recipients" after the count, so a report with one recipient reads "1 recipients".

This triage rests on the issue as it was filed and on what RepoMind's own reads of the repository returned. If any of it looks wrong, a maintainer can change the label or close the draft pull request. Nothing has been merged.
